title: Console essentials: trim exploratory trace heatmap and per-route cost UI to ship lightweight Insights
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures a deliberate downscoping decision for the Console Insights slice: remove the exploratory per-route heatmap and the fully interactive long-trace waterfall viewer from the initial release and replace them with compact, high-value surfaces that meet enterprise needs while keeping delivery risk low.
background: During alpha demos we found the heatmap and the full trace UI added significant engineering risk (complex aggregation queries, heavy frontend rendering of thousands of spans) and delayed other critical items (cost breakdown per route, rollouts integration). Customers value quick visibility into top offenders and cost drivers more than a fully exploratory trace surface for the first public release.
changed_requirements: Original requirement: interactive per-route heatmap (day/hour level granularity) + full waterfall trace explorer + unlimited CSV export. New requirement: 1) Top-10 slow routes card (aggregated latency, Q95, error rate); 2) Aggregated cost-per-route bar with CSV export for top-100 routes only; 3) Sampled trace snippets (up to 3 spans) inline for each top route with link to raw trace data for deeper debugging; 4) Trace waterfall explorer deferred to a post-launch epic. Retention for aggregated metrics set to 30 days for the initial release.
tradeoffs: Pros: reduces backend complexity, avoids heavy frontend rendering, faster shipping, lower infra cost. Cons: loses deep exploratory debugging in-console for early customers; may increase support requests for full traces. Mitigations: provide a clear link to raw traces (S3/ES) and a temporary Ops debug playbook, and prioritize trace explorer in next cycle if customer demand is high.
decisions: 1) Defer full trace waterfall explorer (decision made 2026-03-11). 2) Implement top-10 routes + sampled snippets as MVP surface. 3) Limit CSV exports to top-100 routes to bound query cost. 4) Default sampling rate set to 0.5% for platform-wide traces; per-customer increases require Dedicated/Partner plan. Decisions documented in Confluence: https://rwd/confluence/console-insights/scope-downscope-2026-03-11.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Top-10 routes card displays within 300ms median for UI queries against the analytics API for a dataset of 30 days with 10M requests/day. 2) Aggregated cost-per-route bar matches billing data within 3% for the sample customer used in QA. 3) Inline sampled trace snippets (3 spans) load within 400ms and show correct timestamp/span duration. 4) CSV export for top-100 routes finishes within 30s and contains correct columns: route, total_requests, p50, p95, errors, cost_usd. 5) UX copy and Figma flows signed off by design. 6) Backend telemetry added: API latency, query cost estimate, and sample rate metrics instrumented and visible in staging dashboards. 7) E2E smoke test created and green in CI. 8) Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng lead, Design) recorded in ticket comments.
metrics_and_slos: - UI API median latency target: <=300ms for summary cards. - Trace snippet render: <=500ms. - Cost accuracy: <=3% divergence vs billing window. - Aggregated queries must not increase 95th percentile DB CPU by more than 10% on staging with realistic load.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature gated behind 'insights-lite' flag. 2) Internal dogfood for 2 weeks (engineering/org rollout). 3) Beta invite to 5 existing customers for feedback. 4) Monitor key metrics (api latency, export job queue, support tickets). 5) If any of the four hard acceptance criteria fail, revert gate and open follow-up ENG ticket. 6) Post-launch follow-up: collect feature usage for 30 days to inform full trace explorer priority.
notes_and_links: Design: https://figma.com/file/console/insights-lite | PRD: https://rwd/confluence/console-insights/prd-2026-02 | GH: https://github.com/rwd/console/pull/4823 | Staging dashboard: https://grafana.rwd/d/insights-lite | Support playbook (ops): https://rwd/docs/ops/trace-debug-playbook
qa_checks: - Unit tests for aggregation endpoints present. - Integration tests validating cost calculation against synthetic billing dataset. - Manual QA checklist: data freshness, CSV columns, UX copy, sampling toggles. - Accessibility: screen reader labels for cards and export buttons.
remarks: This cut preserves the highest value surfaces (route-level latency and cost) while avoiding a large, risky engineering lift. We will track feedback and escalate the trace explorer if multiple beta customers request deeper in-console debugging.
